In the Bus-Sleep Mode the corresponding bit of
Network-
State BitVector
, which represents the relevant logical network, shall be 0.
⌋
(RS_Nm_00050)
Note: In Bus-Sleep Mode, it is assumed that all nodes in a cluster are in this state.
Typically, all nodes request the communication approximately at the same time by a
common trigger, for instance a wake-up line.
